title: Casper and the Well
author: Silas Galloway
blurb: Silas Joubert, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
